text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "the early detection of crises is to be strengthened in order to be able to react to changes in the situation in a timely manner", "gist": "Early crisis detection will be enhanced for timely response to situational changes"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "the new Ordinance on the Crisis Organisation of the Federal Administration (OCOFA)", "gist": "New ordinance governing crisis organization in the Federal Administration"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Federal Council", "gist": "Swiss Federal Council"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The new Ordinance on the Crisis Organisation of the Federal Administration (OCOFA) was drafted on the basis of the Federal Council's decision", "gist": "OCOFA was created following a Federal Council decision"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "the focus is on the Federal Administration's realigned crisis management with three key elements", "gist": "Focus is on revised crisis management with three core elements"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Another important component of the Federal Administration's new crisis organisation is how to systematically include the cantons, the scientific community and, if necessary, other stakeholders in crisis teams", "gist": "Systematic inclusion of cantons, science, and other stakeholders in crisis teams is a key part of the new system"}]}
